title: Product & Service Policy
intro:
At Taptales Studio, we are dedicated to creating high-quality applications, games, and digital experiences.

This Product & Service Policy outlines our approach to product quality, responsible use, purchases, customer support, and ongoing improvements.
body:
## Our Product Commitment

We strive to deliver digital products that are:

- Creative and enjoyable.
- Reliable and user-friendly.
- Designed with privacy and security in mind.
- Accessible to a broad range of users.
- Continuously improved through feedback and updates.

## Fair Play and Responsible Use

We encourage a fair and respectful environment across our games and applications.

Users must not:

- Exploit bugs or vulnerabilities to gain unfair advantages.
- Use unauthorized cheating tools or modifications.
- Harass, threaten, or abuse other users.
- Distribute malicious software through our Services.
- Interfere with normal application or game operations.

Violations may result in warnings, feature restrictions, or account suspension, depending on severity and applicable requirements.

## Updates and Maintenance

We may release updates to improve performance, introduce features, resolve bugs, or strengthen security.

Some updates may be necessary for continued compatibility or access.

We may also perform maintenance or temporarily suspend certain services when required.

## Purchases, Billing, and Refunds

Certain products may include premium features, in-app purchases, or subscriptions.

All applicable prices and purchase conditions will be presented before payment.

Purchases made through Apple App Store or Google Play are subject to the applicable platform's billing, cancellation, and refund procedures.

For direct purchases made through our website, the relevant checkout terms and applicable consumer protection laws will apply.

## Virtual Items and Game Progress

Some games may include virtual currency, digital rewards, collectibles, or unlockable content.

Unless otherwise stated, virtual items are provided for use within the applicable game and do not represent real-world currency, ownership of physical property, or a guaranteed monetary value.

Virtual items may be subject to additional game-specific terms disclosed to users.

We aim to maintain game progress and account data reliably, but users should follow any available backup or account synchronization instructions.

## Advertising and Third-Party Content

Some free applications or games may display advertisements.

Advertising content may be provided by third-party networks and may be subject to separate policies.

We aim to provide appropriate advertising experiences and comply with applicable platform requirements.

## Customer Support

We welcome bug reports, technical questions, and product feedback.

Users can contact our support team at:

- **Email:** support@taptales.net

Please include the application or game name, device model, operating system, and a description of the issue where relevant.

Do not include passwords or sensitive personal information in support requests.

## Intellectual Property and Content Reports

We respect the intellectual property rights of creators and third parties.

If you believe content within our Services infringes your rights, please contact us with sufficient information to identify the material and explain your claim.

We will review valid reports and take appropriate action.

## Product Availability and Discontinuation

We may modify or discontinue products or features due to technical, commercial, legal, or operational reasons.

Where appropriate or legally required, we will provide advance notice and information about the impact on users, including applicable purchased features or subscriptions.

## Community Feedback

We value user feedback and may use suggestions to improve our products.

Submitting feedback does not transfer ownership of your original intellectual property to us. Any rights necessary to review or use submitted feedback are governed by applicable law and any additional terms presented when you submit it.

## Policy Changes

We may revise this Policy as our products and services evolve.

Updates will be published on our website, and additional notice will be provided where required.

## Contact Information

- **Studio:** Taptales Studio
- **Website:** taptales.net
- **Email:** support@taptales.net
